{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid age entries: {len(df_filtered)}")
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f} years")"}
